slots.name: Reroll Information
lore: Untiered (UT) items drop with 3 Trait Slots that grant
powerful traits to your character and items.
The max tier and Glory costs depend on the UT's rarity:
▪ Standard Quality (SQ): Costs Glory (above) + a matching
UT Fragment. Rolls a completely random tier.
▪ High Quality (HQ): Costs Glory (above) + a Duplicate UT
+ Frags. Removes the lowest tiers (𖉉𖉈) entirely and
massively boosts the chance of rolling the highest tiers,
while allowing you to pick one trait to reroll only.
▪ Ironman/Group Ironman: Both gamemodes have unique
rerolling costs. Check the Rulesets section for more
When crafted, both Unholy & Voidbound items get rerolls
which are unaffected by the items used to craft
them. They also use a Bloodshot Fragment for rerolling.
